resources.string: Carries alerts from Sentinel Lab on your PC to this phone and your Rokid glasses.
That name leads to an address outside the local network, so the password was not sent. Use the Host address from the Built-in broker panel.

The PC refused the password. Copy it again from the Built-in broker panel, then start the relay again. The phone won\'t retry on its own, because the PC blocks an address for a minute after five wrong passwords.
The PC is blocking this phone for a minute after several wrong passwords. The relay tries again in about a minute.
No glasses yet. Turn your glasses on, then find them.
The glasses didn\'t send their connection details
This Rokid SDK version connects in a way the relay doesn\'t know
The glasses couldn\'t open the alert screen (code %1$d)
Start the relay to show alerts from your PC here and on your glasses.
Alerts appear here exactly as your glasses show them.
In Sentinel Lab on your PC, press Connect. The Built-in broker panel shows the Host address and the password. The phone and the PC need to be on the same Wi-Fi.
Enter the Host address from the Built-in broker panel.
That isn\'t an address. Use the Host numbers from the Built-in broker panel, such as 192.168.0.12.
The port must be a number from 1 to 65535. The broker uses 1883 unless you changed it.
That address points at this phone. Use the Host address from the Built-in broker panel.
The PC only accepts phones on the same local network. Use its local address, which usually starts with 192.168, 10 or 172.
Enter the broker password from the Built-in broker panel.
Searching… Keep the glasses on and nearby.
The relay needs Nearby devices permission to find and connect to the glasses.
Licence file saved on this phone.
That file couldn\'t be read, or is larger than 64 KB.

Rokid\'s SDK asks for a client secret and a licence file (.lc) issued for your glasses through Rokid\'s developer program before it reconnects. Without them the relay still tries the first connection. Both stay encrypted on this phone.
Show a test on the glasses
The glasses didn\'t accept the screen.
If you can read this, alerts will show here.
No alerts yet. To try it, press Send a test alert in Rules on the PC.
